claim_en: THE OWNERSHIP GATE. Conquered, divided, and KNOWN — only then; Jerusalem exempt; on-land only; the good-news reading.
THE HUMILITY PROTOCOL. The owner himself; the two recorded causes; ke-nega even from the expert (Onkelos keeps the particle); the dark house never inspected.
THE EVACUATION. Everything out; the earthenware sermon; immediate defilement inside; the grace days.
THE GEOMETRY GATE. Two beans, four walls (round and triangular exempt), the corner spec; stones-wood-dust or no house; the lintel station.
THE SHARED WALL. Both neighbors pull and carry — woe to the wicked's neighbor; the plaster his alone; other stones, other dust.
THE TEN HOUSES. The complete decision tree numbered by the Sifra itself; return = two beans without spread; the corner-stone asymmetry.
THE ENTRY QUANTUM. Head-and-majority; the half-loaf interval, the Torah's one lenient wash; only the defilable save; the full certification + the teacher's license.
